title: SEC4: let _ = swallow in receipt error path needs context
description: Lines 943 in crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs: When `read_at_unix` is unexpectedly None on a receipt entry, the code records the failure with `let _ = guard.outbox().record_failure(...)`. The swallow is intentional—if the failure record itself fails, we still continue—but there is no comment explaining this pattern. Add: '// Ignore failure to record—we'll skip this receipt and move on to the next.'
